name: Work it out
description: Work the problem by hand on a scratchpad, then type the final answer. The answer is checked for equivalence like a Math answer, and your scratch work is kept with the attempt and shown next to the worked solution.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: Accepted final answers in LaTeX or plain notation. Any one is enough.

fields.name: form
fields.description: any (every equivalent form) | exact (no decimals) | same (also the same form)

fields.name: solution
fields.description: The worked solution, shown after answering.
